description: This file defines the TransferStats class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which encapsulates data related to an HTTP request transfer, including request and response objects, transfer time, handler statistics, and error data.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: Represents data after an HTTP transfer, including request, response, timing, and handler information.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request object that was sent.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response received, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerErrorData
methods.description: Retrieves handler-specific error data, which may be an exception, error code, or other data.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Returns the URI to which the request was sent.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Returns the estimated transfer time in seconds.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler statistic by name.
